keepResults.detail: The live run's own report (cdir run, run_locked) is untouched: a run is always judged on the tree it just changed, whatever other locks exist. — not machine-checkable; human judges

A closed lock can never read better than its last attempt recorded: the verdict, the scope and the checks are that attempt's, and an attempt that recorded no checks reads incomplete, never verified. — not machine-checkable; human judges
Whether a recorded verdict is written onto the lock is decided in one place (finalizeLockStatus), for the CLI's report and verify and for the MCP tool alike. — not machine-checkable; human judges
